ab.seg:
sgyur‹.›lugs la ar rgya na'
'phags pa'o || sa rba na thams cad do || a ti na yod par ro || bada' na smra ba'o || shra ma ni ra na dge' tshul lo || ka ri ka na tshig le'ur byas pa'o || 'bri ti na 'grel pa'o || phra ba pa ti na 'od ldan no || This indicates the Āryamūlasarvāstivādiśrāmaṇerakārikāvṛttiprabhāvatī (ID:3766)

lg.l: rtsa ba rang bzhin rgyan mdzes 'grel pa gsal byed rgyan |

de ltar Read: ji ltar slob dpon mkhas pas tshig don
rab du brgyan ||
de'i ma tshang myed don ti ka rab gsal rgyan ||

seg.note: (This text) is a clarifier and adornment of the commentary (=Śākyaprabha’s vṛtti), which embellishes and adorns the nature of the root (text) (i.e., Śākyaprabha’s kārikā). Just as the teacher, the scholar (i.e., Śākyaprabha), has adorned the words and the meaning (of the root text), (My) commentary (ti ka) on the complete meaning of the latter (i.e., Śākyaprabha’s vṛtti) clarifies and adorns (it).

lg.l: de ltar gyur pa'i bsod nams gang skyes des ||
rang gzhan 'gro' bas srid pa'i chu rgyun rab skams nas ||
byang chub gter chen mi bzad phan pa'i gzhir gyur cig ||

seg.note: Thanks to the merits arisen in this way (i.e., by composing this commentary), May beings including myself and others dry up the river of cyclic existences, And then may (this commentary) become a foundation that benefits the inexhausible treasure of awakening.

lg.l: mi mchog yon tan ldan pa khyed lta bu'i ||

gsung la mos nas tshig don
(rnam?)* par phye ||
thos pas gti mug mun sel sgron me yin ||

seg.note: This is a lamp that dispels the darkness of delusion, through listening to the Analysis of the words and their meaning, having put one’s trust in the teaching of an excellent man endowed with qualities, such as yourself.

lg.l: ya rabs bden tshig srog pas rab du gces ||
khyu mchog 'gros 'dra rjes 'brang brtan (read: bsten?) pas nos ||
gang rten dpal gyi gnas gyur dge' mtshungs pa ||
blang dor mi nus 'jig rten ngo mtshar che ||

seg.note: Which are accepted because they are followed and relied on by those whose gait is like that of the excellent bull, Are the foundation, the source for the auspiciousness, which is equal to wholesomeness. What a surprise that worldly people are unable to accept or reject (them)! (or, ironically: What a big wonder for the worldly people who are unable to accept or reject (them)!)

ab.seg:
mang du thos pa'i slob dpon shag kya 'od
kyis(kyis) mdzad pa'i 'grel pa 'od ldan zhes bya ba'i ti ka tshig don rab du gsal ba zhes bya ba || shag kya'i 'bri gu d+ha r+ma sing ha zhes bya bas sbyar ba || rdzogs s+ho ||||||||
